title: Ledger
description: LED-23. Holds (rate, result, latency) and settlement (time, SettlementIssue count). Latency is mean and max: the timers have no histogram buckets, so no percentiles. Scrape job: Prometheus scrapes each container twice in the dev kit (services, and in-your-ide via the published ports 8081/8082), so every query is limited to one job. Still to add: parked refunds, dead letters and the 6 h parked-refund alert (need item 6's metrics).

list.name: job
list.label: Scrape job
list.description: services: the two containers. in-your-ide: instances run from IntelliJ on 8081/8082. Pick one, or every number counts twice.

panels.title: Holds per second
panels.description: Hold calls answered per second, both instances together (1 min rate).

panels.title: Holds not answered (UNAVAILABLE)
panels.description: Hold calls answered 503 instead of a result, over the dashboard's time range. Should be 0 outside outage drills. Exact count: value now minus value at the start of the range, or the whole value for a counter first seen inside the range (increase() reads 0 for those). After a replica restart inside the range, only that replica's calls since the restart count.

targets.expr: sum(((ledger_holds_seconds_count{service="ledger", job="$job", result="UNAVAILABLE"} - ledger_holds_seconds_count{service="ledger", job="$job", result="UNAVAILABLE"} offset $__range) >= 0) or on(job, instance, result) ledger_holds_seconds_count{service="ledger", job="$job", result="UNAVAILABLE"})

panels.title: Holds per second by result
panels.description: PLACED, INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS, ORDER_CLOSED, DEAL_CLOSED, and UNAVAILABLE (an error, no answer).

panels.title: Hold latency (mean and max)
panels.description: Mean over 1 min across both instances, and the slowest single call per instance.

panels.title: Settlements
panels.description: Deals settled over the dashboard's time range. Exact count, same method as the UNAVAILABLE stat.

targets.expr: sum(((ledger_settlement_seconds_count{service="ledger", job="$job"} - ledger_settlement_seconds_count{service="ledger", job="$job"} offset $__range) >= 0) or on(job, instance) ledger_settlement_seconds_count{service="ledger", job="$job"})

panels.title: SettlementIssue count
panels.description: SettlementIssue events raised over the dashboard's time range (LED-10). Anything above 0 needs a look. Exact count, same method as the UNAVAILABLE stat.

targets.expr: sum(((ledger_settlement_issues_total{service="ledger", job="$job"} - ledger_settlement_issues_total{service="ledger", job="$job"} offset $__range) >= 0) or on(job, instance) ledger_settlement_issues_total{service="ledger", job="$job"})

panels.title: Settlement time (mean and max)
panels.description: How long settling one deal takes. Mean over 5 min, and the slowest per instance.
